summary:
**GrabMars** is an interactive 3D Mars exploration platform that allows users to explore the Red Planet through natural hand gestures, voice commands, and keyboard controls. We developed a system that combines an interactive Martian map with hand-tracking technology, enabling users to grab, move, rotate, and navigate Mars without relying on traditional mouse or touchscreen interactions. Users can point at specific regions, select destinations, land on different locations, and even explore beneath the planet's surface. The platform also integrates voice and keyboard commands, allowing users to ask questions and interact with the Martian environment in different ways.

GrabMars addresses the challenge of making planetary exploration more engaging and accessible by transforming complex map navigation into an intuitive, interactive experience. It is important because it encourages curiosity about space, supports interactive science education, and brings the experience of exploring another planet closer to everyone.
details:
GrabMars is an interactive 3D Mars exploration platform that transforms planetary exploration into a hands-on digital experience. It allows users to explore the Red Planet using hand gestures, voice commands, and keyboard controls.

The platform uses hand-tracking technology to recognize users' movements and translate them into real-time interactions. Users can grab, drag, and rotate the Martian globe, point at specific regions to select locations, navigate to destinations, and explore beneath the planet's surface. Voice commands and keyboard inputs provide additional ways to ask questions, discover locations, and control the exploration experience.

Benefits and Intended Impact: GrabMars makes learning about Mars more engaging, interactive, and accessible. It encourages curiosity about planetary science and space exploration while providing an alternative to traditional maps and static educational materials. Our goal is to make exploring another planet feel more natural and understandable, especially for students and people interested in space.

Creativity and Innovation: What makes GrabMars different is its combination of gesture-based interaction, voice recognition, and traditional keyboard controls in one planetary exploration environment. Instead of simply clicking through a map, users can interact with Mars using their own hands, creating a more immersive experience.

Development Tools and Technologies: The project combines 3D visualization, hand-tracking technology, and interactive software development. Its interaction system translates hand movements and user commands into navigation and exploration actions.

Design Considerations: Throughout development, our team considered ease of use, interaction accuracy, responsiveness, navigation, and accessibility. We aimed to create an experience that is intuitive for beginners while remaining interesting for people passionate about astronomy and technology.
